verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents scoped or least-privilege API credentials, such as per-key permissions, restricted keys or agent-specific tokens. The spend controls (velocity and authorization controls) limit cardholder spending, not API access. The MCP server's "designated set of Core API endpoints" describes which tools the server exposes, not a credential-scoping feature. These are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
